summary: AF-003 Publish Forge editing fix verified end-to-end. Backend PUT /api/publish/posts/{id} confirmed to do partial $set (untouched fields preserved). Frontend: header '+ New' opens scheduler-dialog in CREATE mode; existing Release rows open scheduler-dialog in EDIT mode with title/content/platforms/scheduled date pre-filled and 'Save changes' label; edits persist immediately and survive F5 reload; delete button stops propagation and does not open the edit dialog. Scope respected — only Publish Forge tested.
critical_code_review_comments: PublishPro.tsx (238 lines) is fine size-wise. SchedulerDialog resets local state via useEffect on `open` transition — correct. openEdit sets editing then opens; safe.
Consider clearing `editing` state on dialog close in PublishingQueue so next '+ New post' from within queue always starts fresh (currently openNew explicitly sets editing=null, so OK).
PublishCalendar's SchedulerDialog does not receive an `editing` prop — day-click always creates. This is intended per spec (edit is from Releases rows) but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_HeaderCreate post via UI and cleaned up via delete button at end. Backend test also cleans up any TEST_ prefixed posts.
